offering_description.value: Operates the Weedmaps online marketplace connecting cannabis consumers with licensed retailers and brands. Sells subscription listings, advertising and SaaS software (point-of-sale, e-commerce, compliance tools) to cannabis businesses.

primary_products.value: cannabis marketplace listings; retail software (point of sale, online ordering); business management software

primary_services.value: online advertising; cannabis retailer and brand marketing; data and compliance services

customer_segment.value: B2B: licensed cannabis retailers, delivery services, brands and cultivators; B2C: cannabis consumers using the marketplace to find products and stores

end_markets.value: cannabis retail; cannabis brands; cannabis technology

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly listing plans and SaaS software subscriptions; advertising: featured placements and ads purchased by retailers and brands

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates online marketplace and SaaS tools, sold to licensed cannabis businesses

geography_served.value: global: Primarily US legal cannabis states, plus Canada and some other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: marketplace listings, advertising and business software for cannabis industry

distribution_channels.value: online: Weedmaps website and mobile app; direct sales: sales team selling to cannabis retailers and brands

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: cannabis advertising subject to state cannabis regulations and platform advertising rules, indirect licensing exposure
